_description: Ichimoku Kinko Hyo on daily BTC/USDT candles from Binance WebSocket. Publishes ichi_tenkan, ichi_kijun (current lines), ichi_cloud_top/ichi_cloud_bottom (the Senkou A/B that APPLY to the current bar — spans displaced back 26), and ichi_chikou (close 26 bars ago, the lagging-span comparison reference). Standard 9/26/52/26 periods. Use with: TRADINEBOTTE_INDICATORS_CONFIG=strategies/indicators_ichimoku_btc.json bash scripts/start_indicators.sh
_note: seed_periods >= 78 (52 Senkou B window + 26 displacement) so ichi_cloud_* is populated at startup instead of staying null for ~28 candles.

streams._comment: Ichimoku cloud on daily BTC/USDT candles
